items.source: The strategy can be configured on AbstractHandlerMethodMapping. It is used to assign a name to the mapping of every registered handler method. The names can then be queried via AbstractHandlerMethodMapping#getHandlerMethodsForMappingName.
items.translation: 该策略可在 AbstractHandlerMethodMapping 上进行配置。它用于为每个已注册的处理器方法的映射分配名称。随后，可以通过 AbstractHandlerMethodMapping#getHandlerMethodsForMappingName 查询这些名称。

items.source: Applications can build a URL to a controller method by name with the help of the static method MvcUriComponentsBuilder#fromMappingName or in JSPs through the "mvcUrl" function registered by the Spring tag library.
items.translation: 应用程序可以通过静态方法MvcUriComponentsBuilder#fromMappingName根据名称构建指向控制器方法的 URL，或者在 JSP 中通过 Spring 标签库注册的"mvcUrl"函数来构建。

items.source: Determine the name for the given HandlerMethod and mapping.
items.translation: 确定给定 HandlerMethod 和映射的名称。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
